title: English practice
subject: english
source: Written by the Magana team. Our own wording; not past questions. CC BY 4.0.
review: Sample: to be reviewed by a English teacher before testing with learners.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with cat?
questions.explanation: Cat and hat sound the same at the end.

questions.question: What do we call a baby cat?
questions.explanation: A baby cat is a kitten.

questions.question: Which word is the opposite of big?
Which letter does the word ball start with?
questions.explanation: Ball starts with the letter B.

questions.question: How many letters are in the word sun?
questions.explanation: S, U, N. Sun has three letters.

questions.question: Which word is something you do?
questions.explanation: Jump is something you do. It is an action.

questions.question: What do you say when someone gives you a gift?
questions.explanation: We say thank you when we get a gift.
